Biological pathways affected by IGF-1c

Biological pathways affected by IGF-1c.258A > G. (A) Summary of pathway analysis with MetaboAnalyst. Key: 1, Linoleic acid metabolism; 2, Arachidonic acid metabolism; 3, Steroid hormone biosynthesis; 4, Glycerophospholipid metabolism; 5, Glycerolipid metabolism. (B) Integrative view of the major metabolic pathways affected by IGF-1 c.258 A > G. Acyl chains, circles; genes, rectangles; DNA, triangle. The colors indicate increased (red) or decreased (blue) expression of the gene (encoding proteins that catalyze the indicated conversions); increased (yellow), decreased (green), and no significant difference (gray) levels of total lipid content in mice with IGF-1 c.258 A > G. (C) The interactions were analyzed with Cytoscape. The darker the circle color of the protein indicates more interacting partners (except for IGF-1). The sticks linked different circles depicted the interactions, and the thickness of the sticks was correlated with the strength of interactions. (For interpretation of the references to color in this figure legend, the reader is referred to the web version of this article.)
